SELECT
    w."PAT_NAME",
    w."PAT_ID",
    w."PRESC_NO",
    w."PRESC_CREATE_TIME",
    w."PRESC_DETAIL_ID",
    w."DRUG_NAME",
    w."DRUG_PRI",
    w.package_spec as SPECS,
    w."SEND_QUANTITY" as RETURN_QUANTITY,
    w."PHA_CODE",
    t."DRUG_CODE",
    m.SPLIT_FLAG, --拆零标志 0、否(默认) 1、是 
    (SELECT dict_name FROM PORTAL_USER.PORTAL_SYS_DICT where TYPE_CODE = 'package_unit' and dict_code = t.PACK_UNIT) as PACK_UNIT,
    w.EXEC_SQN
FROM
  CLI_REQUEST_DRUG_VIEW w
LEFT JOIN DRUG_USER.MED_DICT_PRICE t on w.DRUG_PRI =t.DRUG_PRI
LEFT JOIN DRUG_USER.PHA_DICT_MEDINFO m on w.DRUG_PRI =m.DRUG_PRI and m.PHA_CODE = w.PHA_CODE
 WHERE
        w.CLI_FLAG = 'return'
    and w.CLI_INP_FLAG = 2

SELECT
    w."PAT_NAME",
    w."PAT_ID",
    w."PRESC_NO",
    w."PRESC_CREATE_TIME",
    w."PRESC_DETAIL_ID",
    w."DRUG_NAME",
    w."DRUG_PRI",
    w."SPECS",
    w."SEND_QUANTITY",
    w."PHA_CODE",
    t."DRUG_CODE",
    w.SEND_NO,
    m.SPLIT_FLAG
FROM
  DRUG_USER.PHA_CLI_REQUEST_DRUG w
LEFT JOIN DRUG_USER.MED_DICT_PRICE t on w.DRUG_PRI =t.DRUG_PRI
LEFT JOIN DRUG_USER.PHA_DICT_MEDINFO m on w.DRUG_PRI =m.DRUG_PRI and m.PHA_CODE = w.PHA_CODE 
 WHERE
        w.CLI_FLAG = 'send'
    and w.SEND_DRUG_STATUS = 'Y'
    and w.CLI_INP_FLAG = 2
    and w.CLI_EXECUTE_TIME >= trunc(sysdate) - 15
    and w.PHA_CODE != '050101' and w.PHA_CODE != '050117'
    ORDER BY w.CLI_EXECUTE_TIME,w."PRESC_NO",
    w."PAT_ID"

SELECT
    w."WINDOW_NO",
    w."PAT_NAME",
    w."PAT_ID",
    w."PRESC_NO",
    w."PRESC_CREATE_TIME",
    w."PRESC_DETAIL_ID",
    w."DRUG_NAME",
    w."DRUG_PRI",
    w."SPECS",
    w."SEND_QUANTITY",
    w."PHA_CODE",
    t."DRUG_CODE",
    m.SPLIT_FLAG, --拆零标志 0、否(默认) 1、是 
    (SELECT dict_name FROM PORTAL_USER.PORTAL_SYS_DICT where TYPE_CODE = 'package_unit' and dict_code = t.PACK_UNIT) as PACK_UNIT
FROM
  DRUG_USER.PHA_CLI_REQUEST_DRUG w
LEFT JOIN DRUG_USER.MED_DICT_PRICE t on w.DRUG_PRI =t.DRUG_PRI
LEFT JOIN DRUG_USER.PHA_DICT_MEDINFO m on w.DRUG_PRI =m.DRUG_PRI and m.PHA_CODE = w.PHA_CODE 
 WHERE
        w.CLI_FLAG = 'send'
    and w.SEND_DRUG_STATUS = 'Y'
    and w.CLI_INP_FLAG = 1
    and (w.PRESC_NO,w.PAT_ID) not in (
        SELECT A.PRESC_NO,A.PAT_ID
        FROM
        (SELECT SUM(SEND_QUANTITY) AS sq, B.PRESC_NO,B.PAT_ID
        FROM PHA_CLI_REQUEST_DRUG B
        where B.SEND_DRUG_STATUS = 'Y'
        and B.CLI_FLAG = 'send'
        GROUP BY B.PRESC_NO,B.PAT_ID) A

        LEFT JOIN

        (SELECT SUM(RETURN_QUANTITY) AS rq, A.PRESC_NO,A.PAT_ID
        FROM PHA_CLI_REQUEST_DRUG A
        WHERE A.CLI_FLAG = 'return'
        AND A.RETURN_DRUG_STATUS = 'Y'
        GROUP BY A.PRESC_NO,A.PAT_ID) B

        ON A.PRESC_NO = B.PRESC_NO AND A.PAT_ID = B.PAT_ID
        WHERE B.rq = A.sq
        GROUP BY A.PRESC_NO,A.PAT_ID
        )
    and w.PHA_CODE != '050101' and w.PHA_CODE != '050117'
    
   union all
   SELECT
    w."WINDOW_NO",
    w."PAT_NAME",
    w."PAT_ID",
    w."PRESC_NO",
    w."PRESC_CREATE_TIME",
    w."PRESC_DETAIL_ID",
    w."DRUG_NAME",
    w."DRUG_PRI",
    w."SPECS",
    w."SEND_QUANTITY",
    w."PHA_CODE",
    t."DRUG_CODE",
    m.SPLIT_FLAG, --拆零标志 0、否(默认) 1、是 
    (SELECT dict_name FROM PORTAL_USER.PORTAL_SYS_DICT where TYPE_CODE = 'package_unit' and dict_code = t.PACK_UNIT) as PACK_UNIT
FROM
  DRUG_USER.PHA_CLI_REQUEST_DRUG w
LEFT JOIN DRUG_USER.MED_DICT_PRICE t on w.DRUG_PRI =t.DRUG_PRI
LEFT JOIN DRUG_USER.PHA_DICT_MEDINFO m on w.DRUG_PRI =m.DRUG_PRI and m.PHA_CODE = w.PHA_CODE 
where 
    w."PAT_ID" = 'c0111756' and w."PRESC_NO" in (55478,55479) and w.CLI_FLAG = 'return'

    (SELECT dict_name FROM PORTAL_USER.PORTAL_SYS_DICT where TYPE_CODE = 'package_unit' and dict_code = t.PACK_UNIT) as PACK_UNIT
FROM
  DRUG_USER.PHA_CLI_REQUEST_DRUG w
LEFT JOIN DRUG_USER.MED_DICT_PRICE t on w.DRUG_PRI =t.DRUG_PRI
LEFT JOIN DRUG_USER.PHA_DICT_MEDINFO m on w.DRUG_PRI =m.DRUG_PRI and m.PHA_CODE = w.PHA_CODE 
 WHERE
        w.CLI_FLAG = 'send'
    and w.SEND_DRUG_STATUS = 'Y'
    and w.CLI_INP_FLAG = 1
    and (w.PRESC_NO,w.PAT_ID) not in (
        SELECT A.PRESC_NO,A.PAT_ID
        FROM

        FROM PHA_CLI_REQUEST_DRUG B
        where B.SEND_DRUG_STATUS = 'Y'
        and B.CLI_FLAG = 'send'
        GROUP BY B.PRESC_NO,B.PAT_ID) A

        LEFT JOIN

        (SELECT SUM(RETURN_QUANTITY) AS rq, A.PRESC_NO,A.PAT_ID
        FROM PHA_CLI_REQUEST_DRUG A
        WHERE A.CLI_FLAG = 'return'

        GROUP BY A.PRESC_NO,A.PAT_ID) B

        WHERE B.rq = A.sq
        GROUP BY A.PRESC_NO,A.PAT_ID
        )
    and w.CLI_EXECUTE_TIME >= trunc(sysdate) - 15
    -- and w.PHA_CODE != '050101' and w.PHA_CODE != '050117'

SELECT
    w."WINDOW_NO",
    w."PAT_NAME",
    w."PAT_ID",
    w."PRESC_NO", 
    w."PRESC_CREATE_TIME",
    w."PRESC_DETAIL_ID",
    w."DRUG_NAME", 
    t."DRUG_PRI",
    w."PACKAGE_SPEC" AS DRUG_SPEC,
    w."DRUG_CODE",
    abs(w."SEND_QUANTITY") as SEND_QUANTITY,
    w."PHA_CODE"
FROM
  fxhis.CLI_REQUEST_DRUG_VIEW w
  LEFT JOIN DRUG_USER.MED_DICT_PRICE t on w.DRUG_CODE =t.DRUG_CODE 
                                              and w.package_spec = t.SPECS AND t.FACTORY_CODE = w.firm_id
 WHERE w.CLI_INP_FLAG = 1 and w.PRESC_CREATE_TIME >= SYSDATE - 15

SELECT
    w."PAT_NAME",
    w."PAT_ID",
    w."PRESC_NO",
    w."PRESC_CREATE_TIME",
    w."PRESC_DETAIL_ID",
    w."DRUG_NAME",
    w."DRUG_PRI",
    w."SPECS",
    w."SEND_QUANTITY",
    w."PHA_CODE",
    t."DRUG_CODE",
    w.SEND_NO,
    m.SPLIT_FLAG
FROM
  DRUG_USER.PHA_CLI_REQUEST_DRUG w
LEFT JOIN DRUG_USER.MED_DICT_PRICE t on w.DRUG_PRI =t.DRUG_PRI
LEFT JOIN DRUG_USER.PHA_DICT_MEDINFO m on w.DRUG_PRI =m.DRUG_PRI and m.PHA_CODE = w.PHA_CODE 
 WHERE
        w.CLI_FLAG = 'send'
    and w.SEND_DRUG_STATUS = 'Y'
    and w.CLI_INP_FLAG = 2
    and w.CLI_EXECUTE_TIME >= trunc(sysdate) - 15
    and w.PHA_CODE != '050101' and w.PHA_CODE != '050117'
    ORDER BY w.CLI_EXECUTE_TIME,w."PRESC_NO",
    w."PAT_ID"

SELECT
    w.PATIENT_NAME, -- 患者姓名
    w.PAT_ID, -- 患者id
    w.REQUEST_NO, -- 申请单单号
    w.REQUEST_DATE AS PRESC_CREATE_TIME,-- 开立时间
    w.EXEC_SQN, --医嘱执行的流水号
    w."YZ" AS DRUG_NAME,  --药品名称
    w."DRUG_PRI", -- 药品id
    t."SPECS" AS UNITS_SPEC, -- 规格
    w.DISP_QUANTITY AS RETURN_QUANTITY,  -- 数量
    w."PHA_CODE",  -- 药房code
    t."DRUG_CODE",
    '' DIS_RECORDNO,-- 医嘱发药单号
    m.SPLIT_FLAG, --拆零标志 0、否(默认) 1、是
    (SELECT dict_name FROM PORTAL_USER.PORTAL_SYS_DICT where TYPE_CODE = 'package_unit' and dict_code = t.PACK_UNIT) as PACK_UNIT,
    p.DISP_DATE,
    p.EXEC_SQN as EXEC_SQN_SEND
FROM
  DRUG_USER.INP_REQUEST_DRUG_VIEW w
LEFT JOIN DRUG_USER.MED_DICT_PRICE t on w.DRUG_PRI =t.DRUG_PRI
LEFT JOIN DRUG_USER.PHA_DICT_MEDINFO m on w.DRUG_PRI =m.DRUG_PRI and m.PHA_CODE = W.PHA_CODE
LEFT JOIN PHA_INP_REQUEST_DRUG p on w.INPATIENT_NO = p.INPATIENT_NO and w.PAT_ID = p.PAT_ID and w.ORDER_SUB_NO = p.ORDER_SUB_NO and w.MO_ORDER = p.MO_ORDER 
  AND  TO_CHAR(
           TO_DATE(
               REPLACE(w.DISP_DATE, ';', ''),
               'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS'
           ),
           'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
       ) = p.DISP_DATE
where w.DISP_QUANTITY < 0
    and w.REQUEST_DATE >= trunc(sysdate) - 200

SELECT
    w.PATIENT_NAME, -- 患者姓名
    w.PAT_ID, -- 患者id
    w.REQUEST_NO, -- 申请单单号
    w.PRESC_CREATE_TIME,-- 开立时间
    w.EXEC_SQN, --医嘱执行的流水号
    w."DRUG_NAME",  --药品名称
    w."DRUG_PRI", -- 药品id
    w."UNITS_SPEC", -- 规格
    w.DISP_QUANTITY,  -- 数量
    w."PHA_CODE",  -- 药房code
    t."DRUG_CODE",
    d."DIS_RECORDNO",-- 医嘱发药单号
    m.SPLIT_FLAG  --拆零标志 0、否(默认) 1、是
FROM
  DRUG_USER.PHA_INP_REQUEST_DRUG w
LEFT JOIN DRUG_USER.MED_DICT_PRICE t on w.DRUG_PRI =t.DRUG_PRI
LEFT JOIN DRUG_USER.PHA_DICT_MEDINFO m on w.DRUG_PRI =m.DRUG_PRI and m.PHA_CODE = W.PHA_CODE
LEFT JOIN PHA_INP_DISPMASTER d ON w.REQUEST_NO = d.REQUEST_NO  AND TO_CHAR(w.DISP_EXECUTE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') = d.DISP_DATE
where w.DISP_FLAG = 'send' and w.DISP_QUANTITY > 0
    and w.DISP_EXECUTE_TIME >= trunc(sysdate) - 30
ORDER BY d."DIS_RECORDNO"

SELECT
    CAST('HIS' AS VARCHAR2(16)) AS source_system,

    TO_CHAR(M.PRESC_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
        || '|' || TO_CHAR(M.PRESC_NO)
        || '|' || M.DISPENSARY AS source_bill_id,

    TO_CHAR(M.PRESC_NO) AS source_bill_no,

    TO_CHAR(M.PRESC_DATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
        || '_' || TO_CHAR(M.PRESC_NO)
        || '_' || M.DISPENSARY
        || '_' || TO_CHAR(M.DISPENSING_DATETIME, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
        || '_' || NVL(TO_CHAR(M.PRESC_SOURCE), 'NULL')
        || '_' || NVL(TO_CHAR(M.FLAG), 'NULL') || '_R10_RF_' || NVL(TO_CHAR(M.REFUND_FLAG), 'NULL') AS source_revision,

    CASE WHEN M.PRESC_SOURCE = 0 AND M.FLAG = 1 AND M.DISPENSING_DATETIME IS NOT NULL AND NVL(M.REFUND_FLAG, 0) = 0 THEN 'PATIENT_DISPENSE' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS business_kind,
    M.DISPENSARY AS pharmacy_code,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(64)) AS warehouse_code,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(64)) AS supplier_code,
    M.DISPENSING_DATETIME AS bill_time,
    M.DISPENSING_DATETIME AS updated_at,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(64)) AS source_event_seq,
    CASE WHEN M.PRESC_SOURCE = 0 AND M.FLAG = 1 AND M.DISPENSING_DATETIME IS NOT NULL AND NVL(M.REFUND_FLAG, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(1)) END AS finalized,
    CASE WHEN M.PRESC_SOURCE = 0 AND M.FLAG = 1 AND M.DISPENSING_DATETIME IS NOT NULL AND NVL(M.REFUND_FLAG, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(1)) END AS is_void,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(12)) AS expected_code_count,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(64)) AS patient_ref,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(64)) AS encounter_ref,

    'PRESC_SOURCE=' || TO_CHAR(M.PRESC_SOURCE)
        || CHR(59) || 'FLAG=' || TO_CHAR(M.FLAG)
        AS source_bill_kind_raw

FROM PHARMACY.DRUG_PRESC_MASTER M
WITH READ ONLY

SELECT
    CAST('HIS' AS VARCHAR2(16)) AS source_system,

    TO_CHAR(M.PRESC_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
        || '|' || TO_CHAR(M.PRESC_NO)
        || '|' || M.DISPENSARY AS source_bill_id,

    M.DISPENSARY AS pharmacy_code,
    CASE WHEN M.PRESC_SOURCE = 0 AND M.FLAG = 1 AND M.DISPENSING_DATETIME IS NOT NULL AND NVL(M.REFUND_FLAG, 0) = 0 THEN 'PATIENT_DISPENSE' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS business_kind,

    TO_CHAR(M.PRESC_DATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
        || '_' || TO_CHAR(M.PRESC_NO)
        || '_' || M.DISPENSARY
        || '_' || TO_CHAR(M.DISPENSING_DATETIME, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
        || '_' || NVL(TO_CHAR(M.PRESC_SOURCE), 'NULL')
        || '_' || NVL(TO_CHAR(M.FLAG), 'NULL') || '_R10_RF_' || NVL(TO_CHAR(M.REFUND_FLAG), 'NULL') AS source_revision,

    T.PRESC_DETAILID AS source_line_id,
    T.RECORD_ID AS source_code_record_id,
    T.T_TRACE_CODE AS trace_code,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(20,6)) AS quantity,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(32)) AS unit,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(16)) AS code_level,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(255)) AS parent_code,
    T.MODIFY_TIME AS updated_at,
    T.IS_DELETED AS is_deleted,
    T.F_TRACE_CODE AS f_trace_code,
    T.S_TRACE_CODE AS s_trace_code,
    T.T_TRACE_CODE AS t_trace_code,
    M.DISPENSING_DATETIME AS bill_time

FROM DRUG_USER.MED_TRACE_RECORD T
JOIN PHARMACY.DRUG_PRESC_MASTER M
  ON T.TRACE_BILLNO = TO_CHAR(M.PRESC_NO)
 AND T.PRESC_DATE = M.PRESC_DATE
 AND T.STORE_CODE = M.DISPENSARY

WHERE T.IN_OUT_TYPE = 'OUT'
WITH READ ONLY
